scope: Camera-local exact surface registration; MSAA coverage retained. Geometric CONV registration/evaluation is not implemented.

performance.note: 4x MSAA, native desktop, muted, 24 fps. Four seconds warmup and 12 seconds warm CPU sampling. GPU duration includes acquisition/classification and final command drain. Registration uses a rare CPU count readback; animation does not. No power inference.

notes: All native renderer verification and sanitized smoke runs used Metal API Validation.
Core release and ASan/UBSan tests passed. Native sanitized smoke used ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0.
Production benchmark includes acquisition command GPU duration, all 458 frames drained in each run.
Source changed only trailing whitespace after the final performance sweep; final source/executable hashes are separately recorded.
Peak rebuild GPU allocation is not claimed to be reduced; acquisition uses full dense textures temporarily.
Stored-word equality is independently validated; final shader RGB has at most 3/255 difference across the extra desktop time captures.
GPU allocation and process RSS are distinct views of unified memory and must not be added.
